entry.rclone_missing: ERROR: rclone.exe is missing from this folder. Re-download the bundle.
entry.rclone_broken:
ERROR: rclone.exe is here but won't run.
This is usually antivirus quarantining it (rclone is sometimes
flagged as a 'hacktool' since attackers also use it - it's a
legitimate, widely-used open-source tool). Check your
antivirus's quarantine/history for rclone.exe, restore or
allow it, then run this again.

setup.welcome_body:
This little program downloads Legacy Offline PC and its songs
for you, and can check for new songs later whenever you want.
No typing folder paths - a window will pop up so you can just
click to pick a folder, like any other program you install.
setup.opt_have: [1] I already have the game on this PC
setup.opt_download: [2] I don't have it yet - download it for me
setup.popup_find_exe:
A window will pop up - find and click the folder that has
Legacy.exe inside it, then press Select Folder.
setup.picker_have: Select your Legacy Offline PC folder (the one with Legacy.exe in it)
setup.no_exe_here: Hmm, that folder doesn't seem to have Legacy.exe in it.
setup.download_into_q: Download the game into this folder now?
setup.popup_pick_empty:
A window will pop up - pick (or create) an empty folder for
the game to live in. Click 'Make New Folder' if you want a
fresh one, then press Select Folder.
setup.picker_new: Pick a folder for Legacy Offline PC (or click Make New Folder)
done.not_downloaded:
The game hasn't actually been downloaded to {path} yet.
Pick 'Download / check for new songs' from the menu whenever
you're ready to grab it.
done.come_back: Come back and run this program anytime to check for new songs.
sanity.set_to: Your game folder is set to:
sanity.point_correct_q: Point the downloader at the correct folder?
menu.title: Legacy Downloader
menu.safety:
This never deletes anything on its own without asking you first.
Your save data is always safe.
menu.up_to_date_play: You're up to date! Open Legacy.exe in your game folder to play.
menu.songs_ready:
Those songs are ready - just launch Legacy.exe and pick them
from the song list like normal.
menu.popup_change_folder:
A window will pop up - find and click your Legacy Offline PC
folder (the one with Legacy.exe in it), then press Select Folder.
Click Cancel in that window if you change your mind.
menu.picker_change: Select your Legacy Offline PC folder (the one with Legacy.exe in it)
menu.exe_not_found_use_anyway: Legacy.exe wasn't found there. Use this folder anyway?
menu.folder_no_game:
Don't forget to use 'Download / check for new songs' next -
this folder doesn't have the game in it yet.
menu.goodbye: Enjoy the game! Come back anytime to check for new songs.
